layers.authority: Gwaii Haanas Archipelago Management Board (Council of the Haida Nation and Parks Canada)
layers.process: Every visitor to Gwaii Haanas needs a reservation, the fee and an orientation before entering. Self-guided visitors book and do the orientation online; guided visitors go through their operator. Book with extra weather days.

sources.title: Gwaii Haanas visitor orientation
sources.authority: Parks Canada with the Haida Nation

zone-requirements.note: The lead time is a planning buffer; Parks Canada doesn't publish one. Haida Gwaii's own visitor guidance outside Gwaii Haanas is still to be read.

culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: Visitors are asked to review the visitor orientation and sign the Haida Gwaii Pledge, built on Haida values: Yahguudang (respect for all beings), ask permission first, make it right, and everything depends on everything else. Book with local businesses and operators.
culture-and-protocol.sacred_or_restricted_places: Beachcombing, harvesting, boating and driving all affect habitats: ask before you go, plan ahead and be well equipped. Gwaii Haanas has its own mandatory orientation (on the BC record).
culture-and-protocol.cultural_authority: Council of the Haida Nation (Haida Gwaii Pledge).

sources.title: Orientations + Code of Conducts
